quotes.text: You're not buying AI, you're buying back work hours and you're trying to move those hours into work that matters more.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reduces AI ROI to a simple, defensible business framing.

quotes.text: Because using AI more often is not the same as compressing work. A person can prompt all day and still create rework, delays, and weak outputs that someone else has to fix.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why usage counts do not prove value.

quotes.text: AI can draft, it can summarize, it can suggest patterns, but approvals, exceptions and final decisions still belong to people.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Draws a clear line for where human accountability must stay.

quotes.text: Governance doesn't slow value, it protects value from being overstated. Leaders don't fund what feels clever, they fund what they can audit, compare and defend when results get questioned.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Positions governance as what makes AI ROI credible to executives.

quotes.text: Profit doesn't come from adding AI access, it comes from changing the path from input to action in a way the business can measure.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarizes the episode's core message on scaling AI.

takeaways: Completion rates and badges measure exposure, not change; AI ROI shows up only as reclaimed time, faster decisions and fewer errors inside named workflows with a real baseline.
Finance analysts, project managers and frontline support teams have high ROI density because their work is repetitive, document-heavy and full of small decisions.

Governance with approved data sources, human accountability, use case tiering and shared prompt patterns protects the ROI case, and expansion should follow proven workflows rather than blanket licensing.
hook: Many companies buy AI licenses and run training, yet the same teams still copy data by hand and rebuild reports every month. This episode is for leaders, finance and operations managers who need to prove Copilot and AI value. Learn a simple measurement model and role-based upskilling approach that turns AI spend into measurable reclaimed time and faster decisions.
